// diagnostic

E0722

A `Credential` value is denied at `{sink}`.

What

A `Credential` value is denied at `{sink}`.

Why

The Prelude `Credential` tag denies logging, display, and serialization destinations because they would leak a secret.

Fix

Log a non-secret field, or pass the value through a matching `#Scrub(Credential)` function.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0722: tests/ui/taint/auth_token_keeps_credential_leak_protection.stderr.

Error [E2402]: This implicit fallible call can't convert `AuthError` into `Err` — no declared conversion exists
  --> auth_token_keeps_credential_leak_protection.jet:7:15
    |
  7 |     _ := auth.verify_jwt(token, key: key, audience: "gateway")
    |               ^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: Ordinary fallible calls propagate automatically; `AuthError` can reach `Err` only through `impl AuthError -> Err`
 Fix: Handle this call locally with `??`, add `impl AuthError -> Err { … }`, or change the return type
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E2402

Error [E0722]: A `Credential` value is denied at `print`
  --> tests/ui/taint/auth_token_keeps_credential_leak_protection.jet:8:5
    |
  8 |     print(token)
    |     ^^^^^
 Why: `print` writes to a log, terminal, or serialized output, where a credential would leak
 Fix: Log a non-secret field, or pass the value through a matching `#Scrub(Credential)` function
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0722
